{{Top|leg}}
'''Luxury cruisers''' were a type of [[Starship/Legends|starship]] operating in [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. [[House Barnaba]] of the [[Tapani sector/Legends|Tapani sector]] maintained three luxury [[Cruiser/Legends|cruisers]] with concealed weaponry.<ref name="LE">''[[Lords of the Expanse]]''</ref>
